correlation_engines._comment: engine01 — APP02 enricher (1:1, 180s). Correlates by correlationId, normal mode (delete key on match). Publishes CorrelatedPairs to agent01's pairs queue.
correlation_engines.name: engine01

correlation_engines._comment: engine02 — APP03 batcher (N:1, 1800s). Grouping mode: multiple inputs share one output batch. correlationId on inputs, records[*].correlationId on the batch output groups them. Publishes to agent02's pairs queue.
correlation_engines.name: engine02

correlation_engines._comment: engine03 — APP04 validator (N:1, 180s). Grouping mode: multiple APP02 enriched inputs (by correlationId) are correlated with the APP04 batch output (records[*].correlationId). Publishes to agent03.
correlation_engines.name: engine03

correlation_engines._comment: engine04 — full end-to-end pipeline (N:1, 600s). Grouping mode: correlates APP01 raw inputs (by correlationId) with the final APP04 batch output (records[*].correlationId). Longest TTL to cover the full pipeline duration.
correlation_engines.name: engine04

agents._comment: agent01 — APP02 enricher. Detectors: IF for operational anomalies (latency/size/schema); cVAE to detect when output fields are semantically inconsistent with input (e.g. wrong sum, missing fields).
agents.name: agent01

detectors._comment: Operational baseline: learns latency, payload sizes, schema hash. Fast to converge, catches infrastructure-level anomalies.
detectors.name: if_baseline

detectors._comment: Semantic detector: learns P(result, stringSize | value01, value02, len(somestring)). Detects when the enrichment output is inconsistent with its input.
detectors.name: cvae_enrichment

agents._comment: agent02 — APP03 batcher (N:1). Detectors: IF for operational features of the batch output; MAF to learn the joint distribution of batch-level metrics.
agents.name: agent02

detectors._comment: Operational baseline for batch output: latency from first input to batch output, total payload size.
detectors.name: if_batch_stats

detectors._comment: Joint distribution model: learns -log_likelihood over all numeric fields in the batch event. Flags events where the combination of metrics is anomalous even if individual metrics look normal.
detectors.name: maf_joint

agents._comment: agent03 — APP04 validator (1:1). Detectors: IF for operational anomalies; cVAE to detect when validated output is inconsistent with enriched input.
agents.name: agent03

detectors._comment: Operational baseline for the validator step.
detectors.name: if_latency

detectors._comment: Semantic validator: learns P(validationStatus | value01, value02, result, stringSize). Detects when validation outcome does not match historical patterns.
detectors.name: cvae_validation

agents._comment: agent04 — full end-to-end pipeline (1:1). Detectors: IF for end-to-end latency and size; MAF to learn the joint distribution of all metrics across the complete pipeline.
agents.name: agent04

detectors._comment: End-to-end operational baseline: total pipeline latency, input and output sizes.
detectors.name: if_e2e

detectors._comment: Full-pipeline joint distribution: learns P(all numeric fields) across the complete message lifecycle. Flags multivariate combinations that no single detector catches individually.
detectors.name: maf_e2e

cortex._comment: cortex11 — sectoral cortex. Monitors agent01 (enricher), agent02 (batcher), agent03 (validator). Detects cascades between enrichment and downstream processing.
cortex.name: cortex11

cortex._comment: cortex12 — sectoral cortex. Monitors agent03 (validator) and agent04 (full pipeline). Detects anomalies in the validation and end-to-end segments.
cortex.name: cortex12

cortex._comment: cortex21 — top-level cortex. Monitors agent04 (full pipeline) and cortex11/cortex12 (sectorais). Systemic view: correlates end-to-end anomalies with sectoral ones. EMA conservative — sparse signal from other cortex nodes.
cortex.name: cortex21
